messages:
Alex: rolled out continuous-batcher heuristic v2 ~1h ago; seeing a latency regression on small requests (0-8 tokens). p50 unchanged, p95 up ~120ms in the eu-west pool. anyone else noticing?
Maria: :eyes: yup saw the same on the dashboard — linked the spike to the 09:20 rollout window. p99 for tiny requests jumped a lot. https://internal.redwood/dashboards/latency?panel=small_tokens
Sachin: dug into traces. batch formation shows more single/micro batches being held waiting for token budget fill. queue prioritization change in PR #842 looks suspicious (it deprioritizes tiny requests to favor throughput). sample trace: request waited 68ms in batch queue, then fell back to slower kernel.
Jen: I pulled a flight log from node-13:
```
[continuous-batcher] ts=2026-03-18T09:23:12 wait_for_budget=68ms tokens=4 chosen_kernel=kernel_fallback fastpath=false
[kv-cache] action=prefetch key=ctx:987 evict=ctx:120
[kernel] selected=vectorized_row kernel_latency_est=12ms fallback=true
```
Looks like KV prefetch for some long-running contexts is evicting hot entries and flipping kernel choice to fallback for these tiny batches.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollout continuous-batch-heuristic-v2 by @Alex at 2026-03-18T09:20 (canary -> region:eu-west). :warning:
Liam: repro'd on staging with a small load: `./bench/run_small.sh --qps 200 --tokens 4 --duration 2m` — baseline (v1) p95 ~60ms; v2 p95 ~180ms. Logs attached to the bench run.
Maria: two immediate mitigations: 1) revert PR #842 (fast) or 2) lower token_budget_target from 32 -> 16 as a hotfix to force earlier dispatch. Revert is safest if deploy window allows.
Alex: I’m starting a canary revert now (rolling back to continuous-batcher v1 in eu-west canary). filing a post-deploy check. Also creating follow-up to rework prioritization so micro-batches get a fastpath.
Jen: opened RW-1598 and uploaded flamegraphs + perf traces. Adding unit test for the batch timer edge-case (ensures we don’t wait >50ms for <=8 token requests).
Alex: thanks team. if revert fixes, we’ll do a controlled re-roll with additional telemetry for kernel selection and kv-cache churn. :thumbsup:
